title: Session 73: Context Measurement, Routing Awareness, Recovery Mechanisms
summary: Discovered and designed fixes for three critical framework gaps: (1) context estimation overstates budget by 2.4x — need measured reporting instead of inference, (2) lug creation has no routing gate — should verify LOCAL | FRAMEWORK | SIGNAL before writing, (3) sessions interrupted by OS restarts have no recovery path — need track integrity checks + autosave + timeout warnings. Created 7 new lugs for framework improvement.

discoveries.problem: Wakeup Step 7 estimated 57% context (114KB), actual measured 23% (46KB) — 2.4x overestimate. File size estimation ignores lazy-loading and compression.
discoveries.root_cause: Naive estimation by summing file sizes. Should use actual tool measurement (/context) or measured state from previous session.

discoveries.problem: Lugs created without explicit routing. Only after creation did we backtrack to verify: LOCAL (Wheelwright's own work), FRAMEWORK (affects all spokes), or SIGNAL (broadcast learning).
discoveries.root_cause: No routing gate in lug creation. Ozi doesn't verify scope before writing.

discoveries.problem: Windows restarts interrupt work. No mechanism to detect interruption, offer recovery, or protect work between track entries.
discoveries.root_cause: Track integrity not validated. No autosave checkpoints. No recovery prompt.

outbound_for_hub.reason: Framework-wide teaching: token measurement needs ground truth, not inference
Framework-wide teaching: lug creation should verify scope (LOCAL/FRAMEWORK/SIGNAL)
Framework-wide learning: interruptions are normal; recovery mechanism is essential

local_work_queued.reason: Cross-project handoff feature for Wheelwright (46k → 8-12k token wakeup)
Build routing gate into Ozi work-queue-monitor + extend lug schema
Full recovery mechanism: track validation, autosave, timeout warnings, recovery prompt
Immediate context reduction: defer Skills + lug index loads (35% cut)
Quick win: add track validation to wakeup Step 7 (detects interruptions)

key_decisions: Context estimation should use measured tool output, not inference
Lug routing (LOCAL/FRAMEWORK/SIGNAL) must be verified before creation
Session recovery from interruptions is framework-wide need, not edge case
Autosave checkpoints protect against data loss between track entries
insights: Framework improvements benefit all spokes. Signals are the distribution mechanism.
Boundaries matter: LOCAL vs FRAMEWORK vs SIGNAL scope confusion costs turns. Need explicit routing.
Interruptions aren't rare. Windows updates, power loss, crashes happen. Framework should assume they're normal.
Track integrity validation is foundational — autosave/recovery can't work without it.
next_session_recommendation: Session 74: Begin implementing quick wins (track integrity validation, context estimation fix). Then scope the three epics for sequencing. Three signals ready for hub delivery at closeout.

context_health.note: Context measurement improvements designed this session will help future accuracy
